spec_match.rationale: Creates three real AudioContexts, but when renderQuantumSize is absent it displays an assumed 128 as if measured ('renderQuantumSize' in ctx ? ... : 128, line 288), has no unsupported banner, and crowns a 'Best outputLatency' hint among three identical fallback readings — misleading presentation on pre-151 builds.

interactive.rationale: 'Run benchmark' executes the three-context comparison and renders per-context metrics.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Delivers the promised three-hint latency comparison mechanically.

edge_cases.rationale: The unsupported branch — the only one this build hits — is neither detected nor labelled, so identical readings are presented as a meaningful ranking.

references.rationale: No chromestatus link or external references on the page.

conformance.rationale: Feature-level suite renders honestly at 2 pass / 5 fail, contradicting the page's implicit support claim.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless CDP 2026-08-16: benchmark ran; all three contexts reported quantumSize=128, baseLatency 10.00ms, outputLatency 0.00ms; zero console errors.

accessibility.rationale: Native button, but benchmark results and the 'best' verdict are unannounced.

openQuestions.title: Label assumed quantum values and suppress the 'best' verdict when hints are ignored
openQuestions.detail: On builds without renderQuantumSize the page shows 128 as though read from the context and declares renderSizeHint "256" the best despite identical 0.00ms readings. Mirror the sibling pages: show 'not exposed — Chrome 151+' for the quantum, and only rank hints when at least one reading differs; otherwise say the hint made no observable difference here.

guidanceConsulted.query: review pass: accessible live output, honest capability fallbacks, keyboard operability for existing concept demo
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Verify semantic controls, live-region announcements for async state, visible focus, and honest unsupported states rather than fake success.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Review-only critique (no frontend change shipped with it): the rubric applied this guidance as the review bar; the page itself was not modified.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: Headless-Chrome CDP drive of the page's controls on 2026-08-16 with console/network capture.

summary: Driven headless 2026-08-16: ran the benchmark; all three contexts returned identical fallback readings yet the page displayed quantumSize=128 as measured and declared hint "256" the best — no unsupported labelling anywhere; zero console errors.
